research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: XPANCEO is researching optical elements with variable characteristics, such as liquid lenses with variable optical power and contact lenses containing these lenses, as described in 'A liquid lens, a contact lens containing the liquid lens, and an intraocular.' They are also developing augmented reality interface control systems using bioelectric signals detected by contact lenses, as detailed in 'Augmented reality interface control system and method.' These efforts focus on smart contact lens technology and AR interface control.

overview_description.description: XPANCEO is a deep tech company that develops an invisible and weightless smart contact lens as the ultimate interface for AI-powered XR computing. Their contact lens reinvents the whole concept of human-technology interaction and redefines the way they experience both real and digital worlds, including social media, content consumption, and gaming. By merging all your gadgets into one, the smart contact lens transforms the everyday into an infinite XR experience, replete with advanced real-time health monitoring and comprehensive practical recommendations, superpowers like night vision and zoom, and cutting-edge privacy and security measures.
